name: Parallel Panic
source:
Asahi is a well-known hooligan at high school But as he transfers to another school he vows to live right for himself and his loved ones. A big incident breaks out. Will  Asahi keep to his word and live a peaceful high school life after it?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-october-2006-shuumatsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
